check_substitution_associativity.signature:
pub fn check_substitution_associativity(
    theory: &LawvereTheory,
    cases: &[(&str, usize, &str, usize, &str)],
) -> Vec<String>
check_substitution_associativity.obligation: For each supplied case, checked usize i+j is admitted before lookups; overflow emits exactly one ordered i/j diagnostic and continues. Otherwise compare g[j]h then f[i]result with f[i]g then result[i+j]h. Both defined/equal succeeds; both defined/different emits exact mismatch payload, and either absent emits undefined, including both absent. Preserve all failing-case order/multiplicity. is_declared_idempotent.obligation: Conjoin actual one-input/one-output shape and the explicit slot-zero own-name/own-name table result equal to the own name. Absence or differing result fails; no mathematical idempotence beyond this raw entry.

data_derive_macro_review.records: OperationDecl and EquationDecl own exact raw strings/vectors, deriving structural Clone/PartialEq/Eq/Debug; LawvereTheory derives deep structural Clone/Debug over raw vectors/maps, and its public fields remain freely mutable. TheoryCauchyStatus is a literal Complete/ordered-unsplit-names enum with structural derives. No serial/hash/authentication or hidden constructor invariant.
data_derive_macro_review.derive_and_macros: Standard derive implementations recursively use owned String/Vec/BTreeMap operations; format! creates diagnostics only, with captured exact names/results or decimal usize values. No custom procedural macro, unsafe, unchecked index, narrowing, floating operation, hidden numeric extension, callback or production assert.
data_derive_macro_review.failure: Slot overflow is an explicit ordinary diagnostic, before lookup; undefined/mismatch are ordinary diagnostics. Missing split evidence becomes an unsplit name. Empty inventory is vacuous. All diagnostic calls borrow the raw theory immutably, including stored status. Allocation failure, formatting/stdlib/compiler defects and resource exhaustion remain runtime trust boundaries; no catch-all or allocator-totality claim.

cost_review: Let S be substitution entries, N operation records, I identity entries and C supplied cases. Borrowed index is O(S) references built once in BTreeMap key order. Each query makes O(log(S+1)) lexicographic key comparisons, with String comparison byte cost explicit. No temporary owned String lookup keys occur in nested diagnostics.

Associativity uses at most four substitution queries per admitted case, O(S+C log(S+1)) comparison count plus input/result-string lengths and allocation of at most C diagnostic strings. Overflow paths skip lookup; finite iteration increments remain std slice bounds, and only own slot arithmetic uses checked_add.

Cauchy inventory scans N records; worst case N*N*N pair tests. Each uses up to two substitution queries and one identity lookup: O(S+N^3*(log(S+1)+log(I+1))) key comparisons, with string-length cost. Storage O(S+N) references/retained names plus cloned output-name bytes. This is not a resource budget or a polynomial-time claim in an unencoded mathematical category.

Raw append/constructor/derive operations allocate proportional to newly owned strings/vectors; BTreeMap insert and isolated substitute use logarithmic map access plus tuple string copies; operations_of_arity scans N and allocates at most N references. No zero-allocation, allocator capacity/layout guarantee or benchmark claim.
consumer_review: Live search of local Rust sources finds only lib.rs/mod.rs module exports; no external callsite invokes the raw diagnostics. Canonical category native tests exercise package identity. No consumer claims a certified Lawvere category. Conservative scan of all complete assessment context_inputs finds zero Lawvere dependencies, so no completed provider refresh is needed. Separate external omega packages are not this local subject.
